description.zh: 查询范围，任务开始时间开区间，单位：ms。如果不传，默认查询3天内，最长查询过去一年的录制文件。
description.en: Query range, open interval of job start time, in milliseconds. If not specified, defaults to querying recordings from the last 3 days, with a maximum range of one year in the past.

descriptions.zh:
### 使用说明
本接口用于查询有纪要结果的纪要任务文件列表。
### QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
### How-To  
This API is used to query the list of meeting summary job files that have generated summary results.  
### Queries Per Second (QPS) Limit  
The QPS limit for this API is 10 queries per second (QPS) per user. If this limit is exceeded, API calls will be subject to Rate Limiting, which may Impact your business. Please invoke the API appropriately.
